original.p: Lamentations 3:22-23 (WEB): It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his compassion doesn’t fail. They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
Lamentations 3:31 (WEB): For the Lord will not cast off forever.
Lamentations 3:33 (WEB): For he does not afflict willingly, nor grieve the children of men.
Lamentations 3:40 (WEB): Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to Yahweh.

p.line: It is because of the Lord’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed,
For the Lord will not cast off forever.
For he does not afflict willingly,
nor grieve the children of men.
Let us search and try our ways,
and turn again to the Lord.
